name: Factor Bikes
note: High-end carbon bicycle maker (factories in Taichung, Taiwan and China), led since about 2016 by CEO and owner Rob Gitelis. In 2025 Zhonglu Advantage Global Investment Co., Ltd. (subsidiary of China's Zhonglu Co) took 21.15% and VSI Cycling Limited 31.72% — jointly a majority — from exiting non-management shareholders (Bicycle Retailer and Industry News, 2025-03-10). Parent of the Black Inc component brand.
